And the affix काम्यच् is also used in the sense of 'wishing' after a word ending in a case-affix, expressing the object wished as connected with the wisher's self.

Terms: काम्यच्

The affix णिङ् comes after the root कम 'to desire'.

Terms: णिङ्

The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes after a root, in expressing or making known of a wish, except when the word कच्चित् is in composition with it.

Terms: लिङ्

After the word कम्बोज there is elision by लुक् of the तद्राजा affix.

Terms: तद्राजा

The affix यत् comes in the प्रक्क्रितीय senses after the word कम्बल, when a Name is meant.
